description.value:
Tier Skilled

Activate 10 minutes per session invested, across multiple sessions

Effect each session invested grants a stacking +1 circumstance bonus (max +4) to the Deception check made when the ask finally comes

Establish a fabricated identity through small, believable interactions before ever asking for anything.

cinderfall.incomplete: No counter/tracking mechanism exists for "sessions invested" as a testable roll option; would need a custom counter this pass has no basis to invent.
